description: MCP retrieval cases and separate manual AI expectations; retrieval checks do not measure AI reasoning.

cases.ai_expectation: Choose output type and define reset/input behavior before placement.
Verify voltage and edge limits; do not join push-pull drivers.
Confirm both outputs are open-drain and calculate the pull-up from load.

cases.prompt: Can every MCU unused pin be analog?
cases.ai_expectation: Keep the STM32 note scoped; read the actual MCU datasheet.
Select the physical connection and confirm baud/framing.
Connect TX to RX, check voltage and oscillator errors; no pair length-matching rule.
Label directions and logic rail; review adapter power and backpowering.

cases.prompt: Connect UART to an RS-232 cable.
cases.ai_expectation: Use compatible physical-layer hardware rather than direct MCU pins.
Select a supported topology and exact device timing.
Budget forward clock plus reverse data timing; no invented fixed resistor.
Verify inactive MISO release and every branch's clock integrity.

cases.prompt: Chain SPI devices to save chip-select pins.
cases.ai_expectation: Require documented daisy-chain support and whole-chain frame timing.
Request cable and return-path information and check end-to-end timing.
Establish mode, addresses, voltage and loading before pull-ups.
Check addresses and every fitted pull-up; SDA/SCL are not a differential pair.

cases.prompt: Translate an I2C bus between power domains.
cases.ai_expectation: Check bidirectional support, per-segment margins and powered-off behavior.

cases.prompt: Extend I2C through a ribbon cable.
cases.ai_expectation: Include cable loading and return arrangement; no universal length allowance.

cases.prompt: Does STM32 input advice apply to a different MCU?
cases.ai_expectation: Require the selected part's pin specification and reset defaults.

cases.prompt: How should I set SPI CPOL and CPHA?
cases.ai_expectation: Read both endpoint timing diagrams; do not infer mode from interface name.

cases.prompt: Can I remove an I2C address collision by moving traces?
cases.ai_expectation: Resolve addressing explicitly with devices or bus selection; layout cannot solve it.
Report that this initial set does not cover I3C HDR-DDR.

cases.coverage_change: 2026-09-15.3 adds initial OSPI strobe review; device-specific numerical routing constraints remain outside coverage.
cases.ai_expectation: Read the strobe review, report missing device-specific timing and routing constraints, and require controller and memory guidance before routing.
